description: Same 3 input modes as iteration 1, but assertions are substantive (target specific known bugs in the codebase) rather than structural.

evals.prompt: Run a blast-radius analysis on apps/api/src/services/productEditService.js in the helpdesk repo (cwd: /Users/ben/helpdesk). Treat the entire file as the change set. Produce report.md and checklist.md.
evals.expected_output: Must identify dropship-mode column schema drift, missing soft-delete filter in getProductForEdit, missing tenantId in updateProductDualSync route call, mocked DB tests as HIGH risk, and the broken require path in productEditService.module-graph.test.js.

assertions.text: Report explicitly names the dropship-mode column schema drift (e.g. mentions can_dropship, dropship_setup_source, or dropship_mode_updated_at as referenced in code but absent on live products table)
Report flags the absence of WHERE deleted_at IS NULL on the productEditService SELECT (soft-delete leak)
Report flags that the route handler in editing.js does not pass tenantId to updateProductDualSync (relies on DEFAULT_TENANT_ID fallback)
Report flags at least one jest.mock-based test in the radius as HIGH risk, naming the file
Report identifies the broken require path in productEditService.module-graph.test.js (or equivalent silently-skipping test) — bonus assertion testing for deeper find
Report names the speed mode used (lite/standard/deep) at the top
Report includes a Live Schema Verification section with either actual psql output OR explicit graceful-degradation acknowledgement (NEEDS REVIEW verdict, manual-verify list, follow-up steps)
Checklist is risk-ranked HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with at least one HIGH item naming a specific file:line
Report references at least one pattern from bug-patterns.md by name (e.g. schema drift, mock drift, soft-delete filter missing, tenant-scope leak)

evals.prompt: Run a blast-radius analysis on the symbol orderRouteService.getRoute in the helpdesk repo (cwd: /Users/ben/helpdesk). Start from the function itself, fan out to every caller, every test, every route handler that invokes it, and the cache layer in apps/api/src/services/orderRouteService/cache.js. Produce report.md and checklist.md.
evals.expected_output: Must identify that getRoute does not exist as a symbol, handle that gracefully, fan out to closest matches in orderRouteService, identify recalcCachedCounts mock-drift in test files, and flag the getOrderByShopifyId tenant-scope concern.

assertions.text: Report explicitly notes that the symbol getRoute does not exist in orderRouteService and explains the fallback approach taken

Report identifies recalcCachedCounts mock drift (tests still attach recalcCachedCounts to mocked orderRouteService even though the real function has been moved to ordersGatekeeperService or no longer exists there) — quote at least one test file path
Report flags getOrderByShopifyId as potentially not tenant-scoped (or equivalent tenant-isolation concern) with a clear rationale
Report names the speed mode used (lite/standard/deep) at the top
Report includes a Live Schema Verification section with either psql output OR explicit graceful-degradation acknowledgement
Checklist is risk-ranked HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with at least one HIGH item naming a specific file:line
Report references at least one pattern from bug-patterns.md by name (e.g. mock drift, tenant-scope leak)
Report identifies the cache.js module as a touchpoint with at least one file:line reference

evals.prompt: Run a blast-radius analysis on PR #1856 in the helpdesk repo. Use 'gh pr diff 1856' and 'gh pr view 1856 --json title,body,headRefName,baseRefName,files'. The PR fixes a circular-require bug in refundAutoVoidService.js by moving a destructure inside the function (deferred require). Trace the blast radius — who else uses orderCommandService, are there other circular requires lurking, will the fix break any test, are there sibling circular-require sites that should also be fixed. Produce report.md, checklist.md, and blast-radius-inline.md.
evals.expected_output: Must identify this as Pattern 14 (circular require), enumerate any other circular requires in the codebase, confirm the regression test will catch a recurrence, identify whether the fix's mock-interception edge case is correct, and flag the post-fix sibling sweep.

assertions.text: Report explicitly names PR #1856 (or the head ref) and quotes the production crash (TypeError: dispatchOrderCancelInRexCommand is not a function)
Report references Pattern 14 (circular require / partial module init) from bug-patterns.md by name

Report performs a sibling-bug sweep — either lists other top-level destructures of orderCommandService elsewhere in the codebase, OR runs `npx madge --circular` / equivalent to enumerate other circular cycles
Report confirms the new regression test (refundAutoVoidService.circular-require.test.js) covers the production load-order scenario, or flags that it does not
Report names the speed mode used (should be lite — 2 files, small fix)
Report identifies the input form as PR mode and uses gh CLI to fetch the diff (cites 'gh pr diff 1856' or equivalent)
Report flags whether the deferred-require pattern should be applied to other modules with top-level destructures from sibling services (sibling-bug hunt)
Report includes a Verification Plan with the actual jest commands from the PR description (cd apps/api && npx jest refundAutoVoidService)
Checklist is risk-ranked HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW and reflects a small-blast-radius fix (most items should be MEDIUM/LOW; the fix itself is HIGH-confidence)

evals.prompt: Run a blast-radius analysis on the uncommitted changes in the helpdesk working tree (cwd: /Users/ben/helpdesk). Use 'git diff' and 'git diff --staged' to discover what's changed. Produce report.md, checklist.md, and blast-radius-inline.md.
evals.expected_output: Must identify the unfulfilled→pending rename incompleteness (writers vs readers), the new catalog-scrape batch-ingest route missing from HMAC raw-body whitelist, jest.mock usage in catalogScrape.batchIngest.test.js as HIGH risk, and call out the deleted HTN Helpdesk.env as a secrets-in-git-history concern.

assertions.text: Report identifies the 'unfulfilled' → 'pending' rename as incomplete, naming at least one writer-side file (e.g. fulfillmentReplayService, shopifyOrderSyncService/persistence, or rexSyncState) that still uses 'unfulfilled'
Report flags the new /api/portal/catalog-scrape/batch-ingest route as missing from the HMAC raw-body whitelist (or equivalent webhook signature/raw-body concern)
Report flags jest.mock usage in catalogScrape.batchIngest.test.js as HIGH risk per the project's real-DB-only rule
Report flags the deleted HTN Helpdesk.env or production secrets as a git-history concern requiring rotation
Report names the speed mode used (lite/standard/deep) at the top — for this diff size, should be standard or deep
Report references at least two patterns from bug-patterns.md by name (e.g. incomplete rename, HMAC wiring, mock drift)
blast-radius-inline.md exists with per-hunk annotations referencing actual files from the diff
Checklist is risk-ranked HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW with the secrets-rotation item appearing as CRITICAL or HIGH
Report includes Trace Boundaries explaining what was deferred (large diff)
